# vad-segmenter

> Pure-Python adaptive energy-based voice activity detection that turns streamed audio samples into speech segments for live transcription Python package `trysac-vad-segmenter`, import name `vad_segmenter`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
